basis: The chart title explicitly defines the metric as 'Price in U.S. dollars per barrel'. The y-axis label 'Count' is a mislabeling, as the vertical scale (0 to 35) and the task require interpreting the plotted values as per-barrel prices. The x-axis binds each marker to its year. The highest plotted value (lowest on the page) corresponds to the year 1980, with a y-value of approximately 34.5. This is the highest per-barrel cost observed in the screening cycle.
